description: C-47A-DL c/n 20276, ex-USAAF 43-15810, then VT-CME (Darbhanga Aviation), IAF from 25 Apr 1963. Preserved at Sambra/Belgaum, moved April 2016 to Yelahanka and erected behind the main gate/guard room; photographed Oct 2023. Source WoI Jan 2024, BR.
Installed 2005 as an aircrew memorial. BR: serial re-used on replacement c/n 3H-2010. Source WoI, BR.
Listed by BR as preserved at Yelahanka AFS (home of 112 HU Mi-8 training). No dated photo found. Source BR only.
